```renyi
module names.initials
  purpose: Compute initials from a full name.

public function initials(full_name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased initials from a full name, ignoring extra spaces.
  example: initials(full_name: "ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials(full_name: "  ada   marie   lovelace  ") is "AML"

  let parts be full_name.trim().split(" ")
  let initials_parts be
    for each part in parts
    where part is not ""
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return initials_parts.join("")
end
```

```renyi
module names.initials
  purpose: Compute initials from a full name.

public function initials(full_name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased initials of a full name.
  example: initials(full_name: "ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials(full_name: "  ada   marie   lovelace  ") is "AML"

  let parts be full_name.split(" ")
  let letters be
    for each part in parts
    where not part.is_empty()
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end
```
